title: A-A pair at rest, r0 = 2.5, T = 1.5: close approach below separation 3
pitch: Two A at rest, separation 2.5 (centre (5,5), horizontal), tracked for T = 1.5 at dt 0.001. No A-A run has measured a pair below separation 3 at rest. P-0027 and P-0028 hold K at its r = 3 value below 3, P-0024 uses exponent 2.1 at 2.5 to 3, and a single power law with exponent 3.1 would not clamp. These give different close-approach trajectories. One run from 2.5 through contact tests which holds, on the trajectory itself rather than only the window.
